parser_issue_found.function: typed_raw_rows() secondary prefix stripping for separate type/name columns
parser_issue_found.bug: When a separate type column is present and contains only a label such as 'село', source_text becomes that type cell; suffix is empty, so name_value falls back to the name cell. If that name cell itself contains a prefixed label such as 'село Березовка', the secondary cleanup builds a regex by re.escape()'ing TYPE_PREFIX regex values (for example '(?:село|с\.)'); this cannot strip the literal prefix. The parsed name becomes 'село березовка' instead of 'березовка'.
parser_issue_found.control_relevance: All 20 control-row profiles in the current raw context index use one prefixed name column (type_col is null); this bug does not trigger for these fixed controls. Thus the bug is real for separate-column profiles, but it does not explain the current replayed controls.
parser_issue_found.recommended_correction_for_a_successor: Use the same compiled TYPE_RE against the raw name cell and strip by match.end() when the name cell carries a recognized prefix. Do not re.escape() regex patterns from TYPE_PREFIX. Keep source type/name literals unchanged in evidence.
